135:t_1:3.en: ～ $$新地球皇国$$ $$ターミナル・ベース$$ ～

135:t_1:4.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Heh... heh heh... Ha ha ha ha ha!」

135:t_1:5.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Damn you, $$ダバラーン・タウ$$! Always, always, always playing the warrior, putting on airs like a big shot, and then he ends up like that...!」

135:t_1:6.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Well, what else can you expect from the $$ハイアデス$$, a battle corps with muscle for brains? That's the best they could do!」

135:t_1:7.en:
$$ギルター$$
「But I am different! I have the strategy to make any military force submit!」

135:t_1:8.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「...If you get carried away, someone will sweep your legs out from under you, $$ギルター$$.」

135:t_1:9.en:
$$ギルター$$
「S-$$サルディアス$$... General! Did you hear what I said just now!?」

135:t_1:10.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Of course not...! Tasteless as I may be, I wouldn't eavesdrop on some old man's muttering to himself.」

135:t_1:11.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Well... knowing you, I just figured you'd be dancing for joy at the news of General $$ダバラーン$$'s defeat.」

135:t_1:12.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「So I tried fishing a little, and bingo! ...That's how it went.」

135:t_1:14.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Listen, $$ギルター$$... Granted, the $$ハイアデス$$ are a unit under a different chain of command from ours, but they are still allied forces all the same.」

135:t_1:15.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Taking delight in their failure is not something I can approve of.」

135:t_1:16.en:
$$ギルター$$
「I-I know that! That's why I'm about to take the field myself to make up for his blunder!」

135:t_1:17.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Understood. In that case, as originally planned, I'll leave the conquest of $$新日本$$ to you.」

135:t_1:18.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Also, according to the intelligence we obtained here, that $$ゼロ$$ is said to be in $$新日本$$.」

135:t_1:19.en:
$$ギルター$$
「I've heard the rumors about him. That he's a man who has won countless victories through his cunning.」

135:t_1:20.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Known as the man who works miracles... Ah, how dashing. Splendid, simply splendid.」

135:t_1:21.en:
$$ギルター$$
「But his legend will be buried by me. Look forward to the news of my victory!」

135:t_1:22.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Yes, yes. In recognition of that enthusiasm, I'll overlook the casual talk to a superior this once.」

135:t_1:23.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Well then, do your best. The boss is counting on you too, after all.」

135:t_1:24.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Th-That person is counting on me...!」

135:t_1:25.en:
$$ギルター$$
「I-I cannot afford to fail...! I must make up here for my blunder on $$翠の地球$$!」

135:t_1:26.en:
$$ギルター$$
「I have already found the point of attack on $$新日本$$... All that remains is for me to take command and settle the contest in one stroke...!」

135:t_1:27.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Just you wait, $$ゼロ$$! The one who will work the miracle is me... $$ギルター・ベローネ$$!」

135:t_1:33.en:
$$藤堂$$
「Apart from a skirmish on the Hokkaido front, all areas are calm for now.」

135:t_1:34.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「The calm before the storm, I take it.」

135:t_1:35.en:
$$扇$$
「Is the all-out attack coming after this?」

135:t_1:38.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Heh... maybe it's because you're back on your old turf, but you're even bolder than before.」

135:t_1:39.en:
$$千葉$$
「You scattered your forces across every front, so Tokyo's defenses seem thin. What are you thinking, $$ゼロ$$?」

135:t_1:40.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Even with the citizens' cooperation and reinforcements from Japan, the forces defending $$新日本$$ are not many.」

135:t_1:41.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Trying to defend everything means, conversely, losing everything.」

135:t_1:42.en:
$$千葉$$
「Even so, if Tokyo, the heart of $$新日本$$, were to fall...!」

135:t_1:43.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「...I'll answer the question $$扇$$ asked earlier... whether an all-out attack is coming.」

135:t_1:44.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「The all-out attack is not coming. We are going to make it come.」

135:t_1:47.en:
$$千葉$$
「Don't tell me... you're luring enemy forces to Tokyo?」

135:t_1:48.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Exactly. ...Looking at the data from the past few days, the Empire's commander in charge of the conquest of $$新日本$$ seems to have changed.」

135:t_1:49.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「That man will surely attack Tokyo. If we crush him there, the tide of the war will swing our way all at once.」

135:t_1:51.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Then that's fine too. It means the forces that were to be assigned to Tokyo can defend other regions instead.」

135:t_1:53.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「By my reading, this new commander is the following sort of person.」

135:t_1:54.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「He has immense confidence in his own cunning, and aims to overturn a difficult situation and achieve the greatest possible effect with a small force.」

135:t_1:55.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Heh... a man who truly works miracles, then.」

135:t_1:57.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「But at the same time, he is vain, and because he overestimates himself he is weak to changes in the situation, and lacks flexibility and quick response.」

135:t_1:59.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「At the very least, he is no match for me.」

135:t_1:60.en:
$$藤堂$$
「Very well, $$ゼロ$$. Since we entrusted the defense of $$新日本$$ to you, I won't ask for an explanation.」

135:t_1:61.en:
$$藤堂$$
「I'll take the responsibility. Move us however you like.」

135:t_1:63.en:
$$藤堂$$
「What this country needs now is victory, not a hundred courtesies. Don't forget that.」

135:t_1:64.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Of course. I promise I will defend $$新日本$$ without fail.」

135:t_1:65.en:
$$千葉$$
「A transmission from $$カトル$$ at the front. He says a $$サイデリアル$$ force is heading for Tokyo.」

135:t_1:67.en:
$$扇$$
「But, $$ゼロ$$...! Fighting without $$カレン$$ or $$スザク$$...」

135:t_1:68.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I have a plan for that as well. ...$$藤堂$$, I'm counting on you and $$千葉$$ to command the rear.」

135:t_1:69.en:
$$藤堂$$
「You're going to the front yourself?」

135:t_1:70.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「The enemy's commander is coming out in person. I must face him myself.」

135:t_1:71.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「And then I'll teach him... the rage of those who were robbed by someone with no resolve to be shot.」

135:t_2:4.en:
$$扇$$
「Good work, $$カレン$$. I'm glad you made it back.」

135:t_2:6.en:
$$扇$$
「...I've received a report from $$ゼクス$$ about $$第３新東京市$$ and $$シンジ$$ and the others.」

135:t_2:7.en:
$$扇$$
「For now, let's believe they're safe and give everything we have to what we can do.」

135:t_2:9.en:
$$スザク$$
「...Sounds like it was quite a bold operation, $$ゼロ$$.」

135:t_2:10.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「The forces we could mobilize were limited. I resigned myself to some sacrifices and simply took the most efficient tactic.」

135:t_2:11.en:
$n
「I know we're strapped for resources, but...」

135:t_2:12.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I think having civilians take part in the fighting is going too far.」

135:t_2:14.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「No... his opinion is entirely reasonable.」

135:t_2:16.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Then let me ask you in return. Neither you nor $n are soldiers, yet you fight in $c, do you not?」
